blocks.text: 2 Kings 4 contains 44 verses. It opens with: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear Jehovah: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two children to be bondmen. It concludes with: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of Jehovah.
